useCase: Localizing manipulated regions and creating 篡改 probability heatmaps
mechanism: Divides the image into overlapping patches and classifies each independently using a lightweight CNN. Creates a spatial probability map showing 篡改 likelihood per region. Aggregates patch-level predictions for an overall assessment. Effective at localizing manipulated regions 内的 an image.
accuracy: 中-高 - 80-88% for detecting local 篡改s
name: 基于块的取证分析 (CNN)
source: Chai et al. (2020) - What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize, ECCV
parameters: Patch size: 128x128, Stride: 64, CNN: custom lightweight (4 conv layers), Aggregation: mean + max pooling of patch scores
description: 使用 CNN classifiers on small image patches 以检测 local 篡改s. Each patch is independently classified, creating a 篡改 probability map.

references.title: Chai, L. et al. (2020). What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize. ECCV.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.

strengths:
• Provides spatial localization of 篡改s
• Lightweight and fast inference
• Generalizes 跨 different 篡改 types
• Can detect partial 图像篡改s
limitations:
• Small patch size may miss global 不一致
• Boundary effects 之间 patches
• Performance depends on training data diversity
• May struggle with full-image generation (no local boundaries)
